hypothesis_or_artifact: The fixed closure verdict language (Section 17.1, ADR-010, progress.md).
label: READ
claim_quote:
**The registered primary design cannot resolve the effect at achievable power.
The minimum detectable effect is 49.35 bp per month against a registered BLOCKED
floor of 40 and against a decayed literature band of 30 to 40 bp per month gross
and 13 to 35 bp per month net at the six-month hold. Stage B is never written.
The repo closes on the finding.**
evidence_summary: The repository states elsewhere that the number the verdict is read against is an upper bound of unmeasured size: 'The Section 14.3 conservatism is the only one large enough to matter. A Carhart regression would absorb the persistent size tilt between a mid-cap book and a mega-cap-weighted benchmark, and the residual MDE would be lower than 49.35 by an amount this stage did not measure and will not measure, because measuring it after seeing BLOCKED is choosing a method by its answer.' (REGISTRATION.md:790-796). Section 14.3 says the same structurally - 'The gate can therefore fire BLOCKED on a design Stage B would have found marginally better' (REGISTRATION.md:581-582) - with 'marginally' unquantified. The margin is 23.4 %: 49.3543 against a bar of 40.0. None of the four places the fixed verdict language appears (REGISTRATION.md:812-816, DECISIONS.md:288-292, progress.md:14-18, progress.md:174-179) carries that qualification, and progress.md:174 declares it 'not to be softened or strengthened'. n = 2,581 sessions, one primary series.
recomputation: Inputs: sd_portfolio_daily = 0.014065 and corr_portfolio_benchmark = 0.903981 (portfolio.json:20 and :22), sd_daily_excess_bp = 62.9519 and MDE 49.3543 (power.json:9 and :12), bar 40.0 (config.py:144). Method: the Stage A.1 excess return imposes a market beta of 1 against the universe benchmark; a regression frees it, so bound the beta channel by sd_p*sqrt(1-rho^2) and scale the MDE by the ratio. Result: freeing the market beta alone gives a residual sd of 60.1381 bp against 62.9519, i.e. an MDE of 47.15 bp - still above the 40 bp bar. To reach 40 bp the excess series would need a total factor R^2 of 34.31 %, so after the market channel the remaining three Carhart factors would have to explain a further 28.02 % of the residual variance. The disclosed conservatism therefore does not overturn BLOCKED through the only channel bounded from the stored primitives.
would_resolve: Adding this bound (or any bound) to the closure language, so a later reader knows the 49.35 is an upper bound and how far above the bar it sits after the one correction computable without opening the seal.
confidence_why: The recomputation is exact for the beta channel but says nothing about SMB/HML/UMD, which the repository deliberately did not measure.
invalidation_note: no - the repository is closed, 12d9fd3 is its last commit, and _CLOSED_DO_NOT_RUN_HERE sits in the live tree forbidding further work.
disclosure_ref: Yes. The authors disclose the upward bias plainly and give a defensible reason for not measuring it, at REGISTRATION.md:578-583 and :790-796, and again at DECISIONS.md:29-32. This finding is not a discovery of the limitation; it is the narrower point that the verdict sentence fixed against softening, and repeated in four documents, omits a limitation the registration itself calls 'the only one large enough to matter'. Under the disclosure rule the finding is READ and capped at S3.
